data.name: Ui_Description
data.value: Based on AlteriaX/WuWa-Configs. Every item can be tuned on its own, or left at "Game default" so the key is not written and the game decides. Nothing is written until you press Apply; only the keys listed here are touched, the rest of the file is kept as is, and the old file is backed up as *.starward.bak first. Changes made while the game is running do not take effect.

data.name: Ui_PresetNote
data.value: Loading a preset only changes the items it covers (advanced items such as Reflex or ray-tracing denoisers keep your choice). Fine-tune afterwards, then press Apply. The GPU list is only a guide: pick whichever reaches your target FPS and visuals.

data.name: Ui_UserEngineIniFound
data.value: UserEngine.ini found. It is loaded after Engine.ini and overrides the settings written here; AlteriaX's guide says to remove it.

data.name: Preset_1
data.value: Config 1: RTX 5090, 5080, 5070 Ti, 4090, 4080 · RX 9070 XT, 7900 XTX — ray-tracing config loaded, longest foliage distance (lower FPS than default)

data.name: Preset_5
data.value: Config 5: GTX 1650 Laptop, 1050, GT 1030, MX series · RX 560, 550, 780M, 680M, Vega iGPU · A310, Iris Xe, UHD — removes all grass

data.name: Tweak_r_DepthOfFieldQuality_Desc
data.value: Blur of out-of-focus areas, mostly in cutscenes. Game default: High (2). The presets leave it on; set Off to disable.

data.name: Tweak_r_Tonemapper_Quality_Desc
data.value: Film contrast only (1) removes film grain and vignette and can make some scenes brighter.

data.name: Tweak_r_SceneColorFringeQuality_Desc
data.value: Colour fringing at the screen edges. Game default: On. All presets turn it off.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_KuroEnableFFTBloom_Desc
data.value: The newer bloom introduced with Lahai-Roi. Default On for Balanced and above.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_KuroEnableToonFFTBloom_Desc
data.value: FFT bloom applied to toon-shaded characters. Default On for Balanced and above.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_KuroBloomStreak_Desc
data.value: Off gives slightly lower bloom brightness without the streaks. Game default: On.

data.name: Tweak_r_EnableLensflareSceneSample_Desc
data.value: Lens flare from bright light sources. Game default: On.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_NiagaraBlur_Enable_Desc
data.value: Blur used by some particle (Niagara) effects. The presets leave it on and only list it as optional to disable.

data.name: Tweak_r_KuroTonemapping_Desc
data.value: Overall colour response. Game default: Kuro (3).

data.name: Tweak_r_Shadow_RadiusThreshold_Desc
data.value: Objects smaller than this share of the screen cast no shadow; lower = more shadows, more cost. Presets: 0.01 (Config 1–3), 0.02 (4), 0.06 (5).

data.name: Tweak_r_Shadow_PerObjectShadowMapResolution_Desc
data.value: Base resolution of character (per-object) shadows. Config 4/5 set 512/256 together with the min/max below.

data.name: Tweak_r_Shadow_PerObjectResolutionMax_Desc
data.value: The game's default is low, which is why character shadows look rough; 512 or 1024 already looks much better. Higher costs more FPS.

data.name: Tweak_r_Shadow_PerObjectResolutionMin_Desc
data.value: Keep it equal to the maximum so shadows do not drop in resolution with distance.

data.name: Tweak_r_DistanceFieldShadowing_Desc
data.value: Soft shadows from distant objects. Default On for the High and Ultra quality presets.

data.name: Tweak_r_DFShadowQuality_Desc
data.value: Only matters when distance field shadows are on. Config 1 uses High (3).

data.name: Tweak_r_Shadow_CacheDirectLightShadow_Desc
data.value: Not in the presets. Turning it off fixes the low-FPS (stuttery) shadows in Lahai-Roi and newer areas, but costs 10–20+ FPS and some shadows update too fast.

data.name: Tweak_r_AODownsampleFactor_Desc
data.value: Resolution of distance field ambient occlusion. Game default: half res (2). Config 1 uses full res.

data.name: Tweak_r_AmbientOcclusion_Intensity_Desc
data.value: Higher = stronger ambient occlusion. Default -1, which means 0.9.

data.name: Tweak_r_AmbientOcclusionMaxQuality_Desc
data.value: Caps the quality of screen-space ambient occlusion: 100 leaves it uncapped, 0 turns it off (Config 5).

data.name: Tweak_foliage_LODDistanceScale_Desc
data.value: How far foliage keeps its detailed model. Game default 1.0; little difference above 5. Config 1 / 2 use 3.0 / 2.0.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_Foliage_NearCullDistanceMax_Desc
data.value: Maximum distance before near-layer foliage is culled. Higher = more foliage in the distance, lower FPS.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_Foliage_MiddleCullDistanceMax_Desc
data.value: Same as above for the middle foliage layer.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_Foliage_FarCullDistanceMax_Desc
data.value: Same as above for the far foliage layer.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_Foliage_Grass3_0CullDistanceMax_Desc
data.value: Grass cull distance used by the areas added from version 3.0.

data.name: Tweak_wp_Runtime_SoraGridBlackListHeight_Title
data.value: Flight height limit for distant objects

data.name: Tweak_wp_Runtime_SoraGridBlackListHeight_Desc
data.value: Height above which lights turn off and objects despawn while flying.

data.name: Tweak_foliage_CullAll_Desc
data.value: Config 5 sets this to On to remove grass entirely for performance.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_NpcDisappearDistance_Desc
data.value: Not in the presets. Distance at which NPCs disappear (default 6000). Some NPCs have their own fixed distance.

data.name: Tweak_r_Streaming_UsingKuroStreamingPriority_Desc
data.value: Default: retention and load (3). Off fixes Exostrider armour not loading in Aemeath Res Lib, but Smartprint Cube Reboot textures load slowly.

data.name: Tweak_r_StaticMeshLODDistanceScale_Desc
data.value: Lower = better detail on far objects. Values below 0.5 can make ground textures flicker.

data.name: Tweak_wp_Runtime_PlannedLoadingRangeScale_Desc
data.value: Higher = more objects rendered and better textures in the distance. 1.0 appears to be the limit.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_SkeletalMesh_DistanceLODBaseFOV_Desc
data.value: Base field of view used to pick character/creature LODs by distance; every preset uses 150.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_MaterialDesktopQualityShoulderRender_Desc
data.value: Config 5 turns this off to save performance. The preset author does not document what it changes.

data.name: Tweak_r_MeshBlend_Quality_Desc
data.value: Quality of blending where meshes meet the terrain. Config 1 uses High (3).

data.name: Tweak_r_MaxAnisotropy_Desc
data.value: Sharpness of textures at grazing angles. Available in the in-game settings since 3.3.

data.name: Tweak_r_ParallelFrustumCull_Desc
data.value: Runs frustum culling on several CPU threads. Every preset turns it on.

data.name: Tweak_r_TyndallScatteringQuality_Desc
data.value: Quality of light beams through fog and foliage. Config 1–2 use High.

data.name: Tweak_r_LightShaftDownSampleFactor_Desc
data.value: 1 to 8, higher = lower resolution. Game default: 2.

data.name: Tweak_r_SSR_Quality_Desc
data.value: Changing the quality does not seem to do anything except Off, which Config 5 uses to disable SSR.

data.name: Tweak_r_SSR_MaxRoughness_Desc
data.value: 0.0–1.0, the roughness at which SSR starts to fade out. Game default: 0.6; presets use 1.0.

data.name: Tweak_r_SSR_HalfResSceneColor_Desc
data.value: Use full or half resolution scene colour for reflections.

data.name: Tweak_r_GBufferFormat_Desc
data.value: Not in the presets. High precision normals (3) improve SSR quality; high precision (5) is better than default but slightly worse than 3.

data.name: Tweak_r_SSFS_Desc
data.value: The in-game Volumetric Fog option does not remove all fog; turning this off removes the rest. Game default: On.

data.name: Tweak_r_SSFS_DownSampleFator_Desc
data.value: Resolution of screen-space fog scattering. (The misspelt name is the real cvar.)

data.name: Tweak_a_URO_Enable_Desc
data.value: Off fixes low-FPS animation of some things in Jinzhou and Rinascita, but not in newer areas. Game default: On.

data.name: Tweak_a_URO_EnableScreenRatio_Desc
data.value: Added in 3.5. Lowers animation rate for small on-screen objects. Game default: On.

data.name: Tweak_r_Upscale_Quality_Desc
data.value: Also affects UI sharpness at native resolution. 3 is best; some GPUs default lower. Above 3 makes parts of the UI glitch.

data.name: Tweak_r_DetailMode_Desc
data.value: Not in the presets. Changes object details, lights and particle effects.

data.name: Tweak_r_VRS_Enable_Desc
data.value: Shades parts of the screen at lower rate for performance. Game default: On; every preset turns it off.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_KuroFFTDynamicQuality_Desc
data.value: Lets the game lower the FFT effect quality on the fly. Every preset turns it off.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_KuroFFTHighQuality_Desc
data.value: Smaller is finer: the presets use 1 (Config 1), 2 (Config 2–3), 3 (Config 4) and 4 (Config 5).

data.name: Tweak_r_KuroDownsampleTranslucencyFullRes_Desc
data.value: Renders translucent effects at full resolution. Only Config 1 turns it on.

data.name: Tweak_foliage_DensityScaleLOD_DrawCallOptimize_Desc
data.value: Optimises draw calls for the foliage density LOD scale. Game default: Off; every preset turns it on.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_InteractionEffect_EnableBushInteractionEffect_Desc
data.value: Bushes reacting to the character. Config 5 turns it off.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_InteractionEffect_EnableFoliageEffect_Desc
data.value: Foliage reacting to the character. Config 5 turns it off.

data.name: Tweak_r_Kuro_InteractionEffect_UseCppWaterEffect_Desc
data.value: Ripples when flying close to water or casting skills. Game default: On; Config 5 turns it off.

data.name: Tweak_r_HZBOcclusion_Desc
data.value: Not in the presets. HZB reduces white spots when turning the camera (Vault Underground, Minos Sewers…) but lowers FPS in some areas.

data.name: Tweak_r_PSO_CacheEvictScheme_Desc
data.value: Not in the presets. LRU was the default up to 3.5.

data.name: Tweak_r_PSO_LRUCapacity_Desc
data.value: Not in the presets. Default 2000; below 1000 objects and UI may not render properly and flicker.

data.name: Tweak_Kuro_Blueprint_EnableGameBudget_Desc
data.value: Not in the presets. Off fixes low-FPS animation in Septimont/Lahai-Roi but disables some interactive quest objects (Honami umbrella, Lahai-Roi ball).

data.name: Tweak_t_Streamline_Reflex_Enable_Desc
data.value: Not in the presets. Has no effect on RTX 40/50 while Frame Generation is on.

data.name: Tweak_t_Streamline_Reflex_Mode_Desc
data.value: Low latency, or low latency with boost.

data.name: Tweak_r_RayTracing_LoadConfig_Desc
data.value: Must be set before launching the game. Config 1 turns it on; turn it off if you do not use ray tracing.

data.name: Tweak_r_Lumen_ScreenProbeGather_Temporal_DistanceThreshold_Desc
data.value: Lower reduces ghosting behind characters near walls/foliage but increases flicker. Default 0.05 (Low/Medium), 0.03 (High).

data.name: Tweak_r_Lumen_Reflections_AsyncCompute_Desc
data.value: May improve performance on some GPUs. Game default: Off.

data.name: Tweak_r_Lumen_Reflections_ScreenTraces_Desc
data.value: Off fixes SSR-like problems (e.g. blocky shadows on characters/objects) but some objects are no longer reflected.

data.name: Tweak_r_Lumen_Reflections_SmoothBias_Desc
data.value: 0–1, default 0.5. Global roughness bias for Lumen reflections; 1 is a full mirror.

data.name: Tweak_r_Lumen_Reflections_DownsampleFactor_Desc
data.value: Set to full res to keep RT High reflections while using RT Low/Medium for GI and shadows.

data.name: Tweak_r_Lumen_TranslucencyReflections_FrontLayer_Allow_Desc
data.value: As above: part of keeping RT High reflections.

data.name: Tweak_r_Water_SingleLayer_Reflection_DownsampleCheckerboard_Desc
data.value: Off as part of keeping RT High reflections.

data.name: Tweak_r_Reflections_Denoiser_Desc
data.value: Off together with the TAA/filter items below for DLSS Preset L/M. Only works well with RT High.

data.name: Tweak_r_Water_SingleLayer_SSRTAA_Desc
data.value: Off together with the reflection denoiser.

data.name: Tweak_r_Lumen_Reflections_BilateralFilter_Desc
data.value: Off together with the reflection denoiser.

data.name: Tweak_r_Lumen_Reflections_Temporal_Desc
data.value: Off together with the reflection denoiser.

data.name: Tweak_r_Lumen_Reflections_ScreenSpaceReconstruction_Desc
data.value: Off together with the reflection denoiser.

data.name: Tweak_r_NGX_DLSS_DenoiserMode_Desc
data.value: Demanding. Use together with the denoiser/TAA items above turned off.

data.name: Tweak_bEnableFOVScaling_Desc
data.value: Off so mouse sensitivity does not change with field of view.
